title: This change enables dropping config files similar to /etc/update-manager/release-upgrades into the corresponding subfolder at /etc/update-manager/release-upgrades.d/. All *.cfg files present are read and the lexically last one is taken.
description:
This change enables dropping config files similar to /etc/update-manager/release-upgrades into the corresponding subfolder at /etc/update-manager/release-upgrades.d/. All *.cfg files present are read and the lexically last one is taken.

This is to enable setting the Prompt value from a configuration package which only drops a config file into this folder instead of sed'ing /etc/update-manager/release-upgrades directly.

+    def _parse_cfg(self, conffile):
+        parser = configparser.ConfigParser()
+        try:
+            parser.read(conffile)
+        except configparser.Error as e:
+            sys.stderr.write(
+                "ERROR: failed to read '%s':\n%s" % (conffile, e)
+            )
+            return
+        # now check which specific url to use
+        if parser.has_option("DEFAULT", "Prompt"):
+            prompt = parser.get("DEFAULT", "Prompt").lower()
+            if prompt in ("never", "no"):
+                self.prompt = "never"
+            elif prompt == "lts":
+                self.prompt = "lts"
+            else:
+                self.prompt = "normal"
